comments.author: @ExploreTravelDocs
comments.text: I’ve been to Svalbard, and the thing that stayed with me wasn’t just the Arctic scenery—it was how strangely normal everyday life can feel in such an extreme place. You’re walking around Longyearbyen, grabbing coffee, seeing people going about their day… then you look beyond town and remember you’re surrounded by Arctic wilderness, thousands of miles from what most of us consider “normal.” It’s a feeling that’s hard to explain until you’ve actually been there. Anyone else who’s visited Svalbard have one little moment that still sticks with you?

replies.author: @BestTravel2
